modes.preference: system | light | dark, localStorage key dnd-color-mode, stamped pre-paint by index.html inline script and kept live by ThemeContext.tsx

display.purpose: Page titles: session name, Sessions, Preferences. 28px on phones.

headline.purpose: Session titles in the journal index; empty-state titles.

title.purpose: Index tabs, fieldset legends, transcript section headings.

label.purpose: Upright faint labels, placeholders, meta (no italic in UI chrome).

shadows.purpose: The leather cover's spine and cast onto the page. Sidebar only.

shadows.purpose: Objects lying on the page: ribbon bookmark, campaign menu.

shadows.purpose: Sticky floating audio player overlapping content.

shadows.name: place-rule-line
shadows.purpose: Current audio line in the transcript.

shadows.name: focus
shadows.purpose: Universal :focus-visible ring. Boxed inputs: border gilt + 0 0 0 1px gilt; written lines: gilt underline only.

components.description: The one rubric action per view (Run pipeline, Create session, Save).

components.css: .ds-btn-ghost{font-family:var(--font-journal,'EB Garamond',Garamond,serif);background:transparent;color:var(--ink-soft,#5E5347);border:1px solid var(--rule-strong,#BFAF93);border-radius:3px;padding:6px 14px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.25;cursor:pointer;transition:color .15s ease,background-color .15s ease,border-color .15s ease}.ds-btn-ghost:hover{color:var(--ink,#2B2622);border-color:var(--ink-faint,#716250);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink,#2B2622) 4%,transparent)}.ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gilt,#B08D57);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Rubric outline that fills on hover; confirms deletes.

components.css: .ds-cover{font-family:var(--font-journal,'EB Garamond',Garamond,serif);width:232px;padding:20px 0;background-color:var(--cover,#2A1E17);background-image:radial-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.035) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:3px 3px;color:var(--cover-ink,#E7D5B3);box-shadow:inset -10px 0 16px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.45),6px 0 18px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.35);border-right:1px solid var(--cover-edge,#120C09)}.ds-brand{font-variant:small-caps;letter-spacing:.06em;font-size:22px;padding:0 24px 16px}.ds-cover-link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:7px 24px;font-size:18px;color:var(--cover-ink-soft,#A89170);text-decoration:none;transition:color .15s ease,background-color .15s ease}.ds-cover-link svg{opacity:.75}.ds-cover-link:hover{color:var(--cover-ink,#E7D5B3);background:var(--cover-hover,rgba(176,141,87,.13))}.ds-cover-link.active{color:var(--cover-ink,#E7D5B3);background:var(--cover-hover,rgba(176,141,87,.13));box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--gilt,#B08D57)}.ds-cover-link.active svg{opacity:1}.ds-cover-link:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gilt,#B08D57);outline-offset:-2px}

components.name: Index Tabs
components.description: Small-caps tabs on a hairline; the active tab is rubric with a 2px rubric underline.

components.name: Transcript Line
components.description: Time column, rubricated small-caps speaker, faint upright player, 19px text; the current line gets the gilt rule.
components.html:

a few moments pass
components.css: .ds-line{font-family:var(--font-journal,'EB Garamond',Garamond,serif);display:grid;grid-template-columns:78px minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:18px;padding:4px 0;transition:background .4s}.ds-line p{margin:0;font-size:19px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink,#2B2622);max-width:70ch}.ds-current{background:linear-gradient(90deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--gilt,#B08D57) 16%,transparent),transparent 70%);box-shadow:inset 2px 0 0 var(--gilt,#B08D57)}.ds-current .ds-ts{color:var(--gilt-ink,#86662F)}.ds-ts{font:inherit;background:none;border:none;padding:3px 0 0;text-align:right;font-size:15px;color:var(--ink-faint,#716250);font-variant-numeric:lining-nums tabular-nums;cursor:pointer;align-self:start}.ds-ts:hover{color:var(--rubric,#9E2B25);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}.ds-speaker{color:var(--rubric,#9E2B25);font-variant:small-caps;letter-spacing:.05em;font-weight:600;margin-right:.4em}.ds-player{color:var(--ink-faint,#716250);font-size:.85em;margin-right:.5em}.ds-unsure{text-decoration:underline wavy color-mix(in srgb,var(--rubric,#9E2B25) 45%,transparent);text-decoration-thickness:1px;text-underline-offset:4px;cursor:help}.ds-hit{background:linear-gradient(transparent 52%,var(--highlighter,rgba(222,184,74,.5)) 52%);color:inherit}.ds-passes{font-family:var(--font-journal,'EB Garamond',Garamond,serif);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:10px 0 8px 96px;max-width:640px;color:var(--ink-faint,#716250);font-size:14px}.ds-passes::before,.ds-passes::after{content:'';flex:1;border-top:1px dotted var(--rule-strong,#BFAF93)}

components.name: Journal Entry
components.description: A session in the index: ruled, not boxed; title, description and date only (no status tags); actions brighten on hover.

2-22-2026 -- The Lacunatranscript reviewed
Added Feb 22, 2026
components.css: .ds-entry{font-family:var(--font-journal,'EB Garamond',Garamond,serif);padding:16px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule,#D8CCB6);transition:background-color .15s ease;max-width:760px}.ds-entry:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--gilt,#B08D57) 7%,transparent)}.ds-entry-top,.ds-entry-bottom{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:10px}.ds-entry-bottom{margin-top:10px;align-items:center}.ds-entry-title{font-size:23px;line-height:1.25;color:var(--ink,#2B2622)}.ds-entry-meta{font-size:16px;color:var(--ink-faint,#716250)}.ds-reviewed{color:var(--ochre,#8A5B0C);margin-left:10px}.ds-date{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink-faint,#716250)}.ds-action{display:flex;background:transparent;border:none;border-radius:3px;padding:6px;color:var(--ink-faint,#716250);cursor:pointer;opacity:.55;transition:opacity .15s ease,color .15s ease}.ds-entry:hover .ds-action,.ds-entry:focus-within .ds-action{opacity:1}.ds-action:hover{color:var(--rubric,#9E2B25);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink,#2B2622) 6%,transparent)}.ds-action:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gilt,#B08D57);outline-offset:2px}

components.css: .ds-audio{font-family:var(--font-journal,'EB Garamond',Garamond,serif);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule,#D8CCB6)}.ds-play{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--rubric,#9E2B25);background:transparent;color:var(--rubric,#9E2B25);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s ease,color .15s ease}.ds-play:hover{background:var(--rubric,#9E2B25);color:var(--on-rubric,#FBF5EA)}.ds-play:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gilt,#B08D57);outline-offset:2px}.ds-time{font-size:16px;font-variant-numeric:lining-nums tabular-nums;color:var(--ink,#2B2622);min-width:118px}.ds-track{position:relative;flex:1;height:2px;background:var(--rule-strong,#BFAF93)}.ds-fill{position:absolute;inset:0 70% 0 0;background:var(--rubric,#9E2B25)}.ds-thumb{position:absolute;left:30%;top:-5.5px;width:11px;height:11px;margin-left:-5.5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--rubric,#9E2B25);border:2px solid var(--page,#F5F0E6);box-sizing:border-box}.ds-speed{font-size:16px;color:var(--ink-soft,#5E5347);border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule-strong,#BFAF93);padding:2px}

narrative.overview:
The campaign is kept as a bound book. Navigation lives on a dark tooled-leather cover down the left edge; everything else is a laid-paper page written in sepia ink, with speakers rubricated in red the way a scribe marks names in a manuscript. There are no cards, panels or colored pills: structure comes from hairline rules, measured columns and generous leading. A thin gilt rule marks where you are in the book.

It is one look shown in two lights. **Daylight** is dark ink on warm paper. **Lamplit** is the same book read at night: an umber page, pale ink and a lifted, warmer rubric. The reader picks System, Daylight or Lamplit under Preferences, in a section called "Reading light". The resolved mode is set as `data-theme="light|dark"` on `<html>`, before first paint, by an inline script in `index.html`, then kept in sync by `ThemeContext`. The choice is stored in `localStorage` under the key `dnd-color-mode`. Every token below has a value for both lights, and components use only the tokens, never raw colors.

The density is set for reading: the transcript is the product, so it runs in one column with a maximum width of 70ch, set at 19px with 1.55 leading, a figure column for time and small-caps speaker names. Tools sit in the margins. They are faint upright labels, underlined "written lines" and quiet stroke icons that brighten when you hover them. The only stagecraft is the ribbon bookmark, which drops in once to offer "Continue from 1:23:10", and the dotted "a few moments pass" rule in long silences.
keyCharacteristics: Leather cover for navigation, paper page for content, one serif (EB Garamond) for everything.
Rubric red used sparingly: speaker names, the active tab, primary actions, and the current state of play and scrub.
Gilt means "you are here": the active nav link, the current audio line, focus rings.
Rules instead of borders, entries instead of cards, small caps and faint ink instead of badges.
Two lights, each with a full token set; the mode is a reader preference, not a separate theme.

rules.name: The Rubrication Rule
rules.body: Red marks names and the current action, nothing else. If a screen has more than one solid rubric button, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Gilt Marks the Place Rule
rules.body: Gilt means "you are here" (the current page, current line or focused field). It never decorates.

rules.name: The Two Lights Rule
rules.body: Every color is a token with a daylight and a lamplit value. A hard-coded hex or a `rgba()` outside `index.css` breaks lamplit, so don't use one.

rules.name: The Small Caps, Never Shouting Rule
rules.body: Labels are real small caps (`font-variant: small-caps`, 0.04–0.06em tracking), never uppercase text with wide tracking.

rules.name: The Two Figures Rule
rules.body: Prose keeps old-style figures. Anything that aligns or is compared, such as time, durations or counts, gets lining tabular figures.

rules.name: The Only the Cover Casts Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the page has a drop shadow except objects lying on it (the ribbon, menus and the floating player). Pages, entries, inputs and buttons are flat.

dos: **Do** use the journal tokens (`--page`, `--ink`, `--rubric`, `--gilt`, `--rule` and the rest) for every color, so both lights come for free.
**Do** separate content with 1px `--rule` hairlines and whitespace, and let lists be ruled entries.
**Do** set speaker and section labels in real small caps (0.04–0.06em tracking) and marginal notes in upright faint ink.
**Do** put lining tabular figures on every timestamp, duration and count.
**Do** keep reading text at 19px/1.55 in a column no wider than 70ch.
**Do** mark "you are here" with a gilt inset rule and focus with a 2px gilt outline at 2px offset.
**Do** draw new icons in the `Icons.tsx` hand: 24px grid, 2px stroke, round caps, `currentColor`.
donts: **Don't** wrap content in cards, panels or bordered boxes with rounded corners. Entries are ruled, not boxed.
**Don't** use colored pills, per-speaker color chips, or italic for UI labels. Speakers are rubric small caps, and states are a plain word in moss, ochre or ink.
**Don't** add drop shadows to page content. Only the cover and objects lying on the page (ribbon, menus, floating player) cast.
**Don't** introduce a second typeface for display or UI. A system monospace is allowed only for machine strings (regex, keys, URLs, raw markdown).
**Don't** set labels in uppercase with wide tracking. Use small caps.
**Don't** use more than one solid rubric button in a view, or use rubric decoratively.
**Don't** add parchment textures, burnt edges, stains or fantasy display faces. The only texture is the cover's faint dot grain.
**Don't** hard-code hex or `rgba()` colors in components. They break lamplit.
